about: The Atelier launcher's catalog: it reads this on every start, so apps can be added here without a new launcher. asset and setup may use * for the version. launch: window, console or none. The list is in this order (the big apps first); categories are the launcher's filters.

apps.name: Chimera
apps.description: A layer-based image editor: layers, masks, blend modes and filters.

apps.name: Demiurge
apps.description: Make worlds: a 2D and 3D game engine with C#, built on Godot Engine 4.7.

apps.name: Pygmalion
apps.description: People in 3D with sliders: MakeHuman remade. Shape, dress, pose, render, and export with the skeleton.

apps.name: Terminus
apps.description: Photos to a textured 3D model: AliceVision's photogrammetry in three steps, GLB, OBJ and STL out.

apps.name: Mimic
apps.description: One person's face onto a picture or a video.

apps.name: Firmament
apps.description: 360° skyboxes from a prompt: look round them, repair the seam, upscale, export cube maps. Needs an NVIDIA card.

apps.name: Hymnal
apps.description: Whole songs, with vocals, from a style: lyrics written for you, covers, remixes, stems, tempo and key.

apps.name: Bathos
apps.description: A picture in, its depth map out. Near is bright, far is dark.

apps.name: CRUSH
apps.description: A file compressor, written from scratch, for the command line and Explorer.
apps.plugin: In Explorer: right-click > Add to CRUSH archive
